name: Drag match
summary: Drag chips onto their buckets: correct locks with a pulse, wrong shakes home.

slots.label: Headline
slots.tooltip: The line across the top that tells the room what to sort

slots.label: Chips
slots.tooltip: The short claims people drag into a bucket. They sit in one row, so keep them short

item.label: Chip text
item.tooltip: A few words written on the chip

item.label: Right bucket
item.tooltip: Which bucket this chip belongs in, counting from 0 for the first bucket

item.label: Chip colour
item.tooltip: The ring colour while the chip is dragged. Leave empty to use the slide's colour

slots.label: Buckets
slots.tooltip: The boxes across the middle that chips are dropped into, left to right

item.label: Bucket name
item.tooltip: The short name at the top of the bucket

item.label: Bucket colour
item.tooltip: The colour of this bucket and the chips locked inside it

slots.label: Closing line
slots.tooltip: The takeaway that blooms in at the bottom once every chip is in its bucket

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The ring colour of a chip while it is dragged, unless the chip sets its own

content.prompt: Local or cloud — sort the claims
content.reveal: If you can sort these, you already know which workloads belong on your box.
